query: UPDATE tasks SET run_checkpoint=jsonb_set(run_checkpoint-$6::text,ARRAY[$4],$5,true),run_pending=CASE WHEN run_state='running' THEN NULL ELSE run_pending END,run_revision=run_revision+1,run_updated=now(),run_until=CASE WHEN run_state='running' AND run_until>now() THEN now()+interval '240 seconds' ELSE run_until END WHERE tenant=$1 AND id=$2 AND ((run_lease=$3 AND run_state='running' AND run_until>now()) OR ($7 AND run_checkpoint->$6=jsonb_build_object('lease',$3::text) AND ((run_state IN ('cancelled','uncertain') AND run_lease IS NULL) OR (run_state='running' AND run_lease=$3))))
